تقتعدوا (form VIII)
# تَقْتَعِدُوا (taqtaʕidū) /taq.ta.ʕi.duː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَعَدَ (iqtaʕada)
# تُقْتَعَدُوا (tuqtaʕadū) /tuq.ta.ʕa.duː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَعَدَ (iqtaʕada)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
